name: k03-rakesh-label-photo
prompt:
Inside the Nagpur godown: the distributor (the man in the light blue checked shirt, grey moustache, glasses pushed up on his head) holds his phone up in both hands, its back to the camera, photographing the small plain white label panel on the side of a plain kraft carton with a sage-green band on the rack in front of him. Shot from behind his right shoulder, the phone's back and the carton sharp, daylight from the shutter, dust in the air.

Photorealistic cinematic film still, live action, 35 mm, eye level, shallow depth of field, natural light, real skin and fabric. Every pack and carton is unbranded: plain kraft-brown cartons with a sage-green band, solid-colour snack packets (amber, green, red) with no lettering, Mango Drink as small plain yellow-orange tetra packs with no lettering. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no number plate anywhere. No children.
